resources.string: A transparent camera wallpaper that watches for nearby vehicles and obstacles, with on-device hazard alerts.
A transparent live wallpaper with on-device hazard awareness. Frames never leave your phone.
Camera permission required before detection can run
Live wallpaper is not active yet
No live wallpaper picker is available on this device.
Tap \"Set live wallpaper\", choose Android Clear in the system picker, then return to the home screen. Camera capture stops automatically whenever the wallpaper is hidden.
Suppresses the red visual flash. Uses spoken labels, a low-latency tone, and a vibration pattern instead.
System screen-reader mode detected: Blind Assist is active automatically.
Play a short tone when a nearby object is detected.
Use a haptic pattern for hazard alerts.
Controls how strongly the camera preview shows through your home screen.
When armed, a confirmed hazard saves a JPEG burst to Pictures/Android Clear/Threat Captures. Three quick taps on the home screen arm it for a few seconds.
Slower cadences use less battery. Detection always stays on.
Detection runs locally with a bundled EfficientDet-Lite0 model. No images or detections are uploaded.
Safety notice: this is an assistive prototype, not a certified mobility or driving aid. Never rely on it to avoid traffic or other hazards.
Blind Assist always uses sound and vibration.
These documents apply to Android Clear 1.4.0 and later. The full text ships inside the app and is readable offline.

Android Clear uses an on-device machine-learning model to identify environmental hazards in real time.

Detection is probabilistic and may not identify every obstacle. Weather, poor lighting, lens obstructions and sudden movement can reduce accuracy.

The app assists your awareness; it does not replace your judgement or any safety equipment. Always rely on visual verification and personal discretion.

Android Clear is an informational tool, not a life-safety device.

Do not rely on this application for emergency response, navigation in high-risk environments, or as a replacement for required safety equipment. The app does not contact emergency services.

By proceeding you acknowledge that you remain fully responsible for your personal safety and surroundings at all times.
I acknowledge that Android Clear is an auxiliary tool and not a safety device.

Android Clear needs access to your camera to capture live video feeds for real-time hazard detection and obstacle analysis.\n\nPrivacy notice: video frames are processed locally on your device. Video data is never stored, recorded, or transmitted to external servers without your explicit consent.
Camera permission was denied. Open the system settings for Android Clear to allow camera access; hazard detection cannot run without it.

Battery Saver is on. Android may pause or restrict background processing, so continuous hazard detection can stop until the wallpaper is shown again. Real-time analysis also uses more battery and can warm the device.
